arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various newline scenarios to ensure R1 is satisfied
tests = [
    # Format string ending with newline, input ends with newline
    ('{:d}\n', '42\n'),
    ('{}\n', 'hello\n'),
    
    # Format string without trailing newline, input ends with newline
    ('{:d}', '42\n'),
    ('{}', 'hello\n'),
    
    # Format string ending with newline, input doesn't end with newline (should fail)
    ('{:d}\n', '42'),
    ('{}\n', 'hello'),
    
    # Input ending with multiple newlines
    ('{:d}\n', '42\n\n'),
    ('{:d}', '42\n'),
]

for fmt, text in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, text)
    print(f'parse({fmt!r}, {text!r}) = {result}')
"
